import json, os, sys

SAVE_ENDINGS = "endings.json"

class Engine:
    def __init__(self, nodes, title):
        self.nodes = nodes
        self.title = title
        self.vars = {}          # flags
        self.items = set()
        self.rel = {}
        self.log = []
        self.found = self._load_endings()

    def _load_endings(self):
        try:
            with open(SAVE_ENDINGS) as f: return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception: return set()

    def _save_endings(self):
        with open(SAVE_ENDINGS, "w") as f: json.dump(sorted(self.found), f)

    def check(self, cond):
        if not cond: return True
        for it in cond.get("items", []):
            if it not in self.items: return False
        for it in cond.get("not_items", []):
            if it in self.items: return False
        for k, v in cond.get("flags", {}).items():
            if bool(self.vars.get(k)) != bool(v): return False
        for k, v in cond.get("min_rel", {}).items():
            if self.rel.get(k, 0) < v: return False
        for k, v in cond.get("max_rel", {}).items():
            if self.rel.get(k, 0) > v: return False
        return True

    def apply(self, fx):
        if not fx: return
        for k, v in fx.get("set", {}).items(): self.vars[k] = v
        for it in fx.get("add_items", []): self.items.add(it)
        for it in fx.get("remove_items", []): self.items.discard(it)
        for k, v in fx.get("rel", {}).items(): self.rel[k] = self.rel.get(k, 0) + v
        if fx.get("note"): self.log.append(fx["note"])

    def render(self, text):
        if isinstance(text, list):
            for seg in text:
                if self.check(seg.get("if")): return seg["text"]
            return ""
        return text

    def status(self):
        rel = ", ".join(f"{k} {v:+d}" for k, v in sorted(self.rel.items())) or "none"
        items = ", ".join(sorted(self.items)) or "none"
        return f"[name]  Items: {items} | Bonds: {rel}"

    def choices_for(self, node):
        return [(c, self.check(c.get("requires"))) for c in node.get("choices", [])]

    def play(self):
        print("=" * 60); print(self.title.center(60)); print("=" * 60)
        self.player = input("What is your name, traveller? > ").strip() or "Wanderer"
        node_id = "start"
        while node_id:
            node = self.nodes[node_id]
            body = self.render(node["text"]).replace("{name}", self.player)
            print("\n" + "-" * 60); print(body)
            if node.get("ending"):
                title = node["ending"]
                self.found.add(title); self._save_endings()
                print("\n*** ENDING REACHED: " + title + " ***")
                print("\nFinal state: " + self.status().replace("[name]", self.player))
                if self.log: print("Chronicle:"); [print(" - " + l) for l in self.log]
                print(f"Endings discovered: {len(self.found)}")
                return
            print("\n" + self.status().replace("[name]", self.player))
            opts = self.choices_for(node)
            valid = []
            for c, ok in opts:
                tag = "" if ok else "  [unavailable]"
                print(f"  {len(valid)+1 if ok else '-'}." ...)

import json
import os

ENDINGS_FILE = "endings.json"


class Engine:
    """Runs a node-based branching story with state, items, relationships,
    conditional choices and conditional narrative text."""

    def __init__(self, nodes, title):
        self.nodes = nodes
        self.title = title
        self.player = "Wanderer"
        self.flags = {}
        self.items = set()
        self.rel = {}
        self.chronicle = []
        self.endings_found = self._load_endings()

    # ----- persistence of discovered endings -----
    def _load_endings(self):
        try:
            with open(ENDINGS_FILE) as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return set()

    def _save_endings(self):
        try:
            with open(ENDINGS_FILE, "w") as f:
                json.dump(sorted(self.endings_found), f)
        except OSError:
            pass

    # ----- conditional checks -----
    def check(self, cond):
        if not cond:
            return True
        if any(i not in self.items for i in cond.get("items", [])):
            return False
        if any(i in self.items for i in cond.get("not_items", [])):
            return False
        for k, v in cond.get("flags", {}).items():
            if bool(self.flags.get(k)) != bool(v):
                return False
        anyf = cond.get("any_flags")
        if anyf and not any(self.flags.get(k) for k in anyf):
            return False
        for k, v in cond.get("min_rel", {}).items():
            if self.rel.get(k, 0) < v:
                return False
        for k, v in cond.get("max_rel", {}).items():
            if self.rel.get(k, 0) > v:
                return False
        return True

    # ----- effect application -----
    def apply(self, fx):
        if not fx:
            return
        for k, v in fx.get("set", {}).items():
            self.flags[k] = v
        for i in fx.get("add_items", []):
            self.items.add(i)
        for i in fx.get("remove_items", []):
            self.items.discard(i)
        for k, v in fx.get("rel", {}).items():
            self.rel[k] = self.rel.get(k, 0) + v
        if fx.get("note"):
            self.chronicle.append(fx["note"])

    # ----- text rendering (conditional segments) -----
    def render(self, text):
        if isinstance(text, list):
            for seg in text:
                if self.check(seg.get("if")):
                    return seg["text"]
            return ""
        return text

    def _fmt(self, s):
        return s.replace("{name}", self.player)

    def status(self):
        items = ", ".join(sorted(self.items)) or "none"
        rel = ", ".join("{} {:+d}".format(k, v) for k, v in sorted(self.rel.items())) or "none"
        return "Items: {} | Bonds: {}".format(items, rel)

    # ----- main loop -----
    def play(self):
        print("=" * 62)
        print(self.title.center(62))
        print("=" * 62)
        self.player = input("What is your name, traveller? > ").strip() or "Wanderer"
        node_id = "start"
        while node_id:
            node = self.nodes.get(node_id)
            if node is None:
                print("[story error: missing node '{}']".format(node_id))
                return
            print("\n" + "-" * 62)
            print(self._fmt(self.render(node["text"])))
            if node.get("ending"):
                self._finish(node["ending"])
                return
            print("\n(" + self.status() + ")")
            available = []
            for c in node.get("choices", []):
                if self.check(c.get("requires")):
                    available.append(c)
                    print("  {}. {}".format(len(available), c["text"]))
                else:
                    print("     - {} (unavailable)".format(c["text"]))
            if not available:
                node_id = node.get("fallback")
                if not node_id:
                    print("\nThe path fades here. Your tale ends unresolved.")
                    return
                continue
            sel = input("\nChoose a number (q to quit) > ").strip().lower()
            if sel == "q":
                print("\nFarewell, {}.".format(self.player))
                return
            if not sel.isdigit() or not 1 <= int(sel) <= len(available):
                print("Please enter a valid number.")
                continue
            choice = available[int(sel) - 1]
            self.apply(choice.get("effects"))
            node_id = choice["next"]

    def _finish(self, title):
        self.endings_found.add(title)
        self._save_endings()
        print("\n" + "*" * 62)
        print("*** ENDING REACHED: {} ***".format(title))
        print("*" * 62)
        print("\nFinal state: " + self.status())
        if self.chronicle:
            print("\nChronicle of deeds:")
            for line in self.chronicle:
                print(" - " + line)
        print("\nEndings discovered so far: {} of {}".format(
            len(self.endings_found), len({n["ending"] for n in self.nodes.values() if n.get("ending")})))

import json, os, re

class Engine:
    def __init__(self, story, save_dir="saves"):
        self.story = story
        self.save_dir = save_dir
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self.node = self.story["start_node"]
        self.items = set()
        self.flags = set()
        self.rel = {}
        self.log = []

    def _cmp(self, a, op, b):
        return {"<": a<b, ">": a>b, "<=": a<=b, ">=": a>=b, "==": a==b, "!=": a!=b}[op]

    def check(self, cond):
        cond = cond.strip()
        if cond.startswith("not "):
            return not self.check(cond[4:])
        m = re.match(r"item:(\w+)$", cond)
        if m: return m.group(1) in self.items
        m = re.match(r"flag:(\w+)$", cond)
        if m: return m.group(1) in self.flags
        m = re.match(r"rel:(\w+)\s*(>=|<=|==|!=|>|<)\s*(-?\d+)$", cond)
        if m: return self._cmp(self.rel.get(m.group(1), 0), m.group(2), int(m.group(3)))
        raise ValueError("bad condition: " + cond)

    def apply(self, effects):
        if not effects: return
        for it in effects.get("items", []):
            if it.startswith("-"): self.items.discard(it[1:])
            else: self.items.add(it)
        for f in effects.get("flags", []): self.flags.add(f)
        for k, v in effects.get("rel", {}).items():
            self.rel[k] = self.rel.get(k, 0) + v

    def available(self, node):
        return [c for c in node.get("choices", []) if all(self.check(x) for x in c.get("cond", []))]

    def save(self, name):
        os.makedirs(self.save_dir, exist_ok=True)
        data = {"node": self.node, "items": sorted(self.items), "flags": sorted(self.flags), "rel": self.rel, "log": self.log}
        with open(os.path.join(self.save_dir, name + ".json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f)

    def load(self, name):
        path = os.path.join(self.save_dir, name + ".json")
        with open(path) as f: data = json.load(f)
        self.node = data["node"]; self.items = set(data["items"]); self.flags = set(data["flags"]); self.rel = data["rel"]; self.log = data["log"]

"""Story engine: state tracking, condition checks, effects, branching, saves."""
import json
import os
import re


class Engine:
    def __init__(self, story, save_dir="saves"):
        self.story = story
        self.save_dir = save_dir
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self.node = self.story["start_node"]
        self.items = set()
        self.flags = set()
        self.rel = {}
        self.log = []

    @staticmethod
    def _cmp(a, op, b):
        return {"<": a < b, ">": a > b, "<=": a <= b,
                ">=": a >= b, "==": a == b, "!=": a != b}[op]

    def check(self, cond):
        """Evaluate a condition string against current state."""
        cond = cond.strip()
        if cond.startswith("not "):
            return not self.check(cond[4:])
        m = re.fullmatch(r"item:(\w+)", cond)
        if m:
            return m.group(1) in self.items
        m = re.fullmatch(r"flag:(\w+)", cond)
        if m:
            return m.group(1) in self.flags
        m = re.fullmatch(r"rel:(\w+)\s*(>=|<=|==|!=|>|<)\s*(-?\d+)", cond)
        if m:
            return self._cmp(self.rel.get(m.group(1), 0), m.group(2), int(m.group(3)))
        raise ValueError("bad condition: " + cond)

    def apply(self, effects):
        """Apply a choice's effects to state."""
        if not effects:
            return
        for it in effects.get("items", []):
            if it.startswith("-"):
                self.items.discard(it[1:])
            else:
                self.items.add(it)
        for f in effects.get("flags", []):
            self.flags.add(f)
        for name, delta in effects.get("rel", {}).items():
            self.rel[name] = self.rel.get(name, 0) + delta

    def available(self, node):
        """Choices whose conditions all pass."""
        return [c for c in node.get("choices", [])
                if all(self.check(x) for x in c.get("cond", []))]

    def status(self):
        print("\n-- State --")
        print("Items:", ", ".join(sorted(self.items)) or "none")
        print("Flags:", ", ".join(sorted(self.flags)) or "none")
        print("Relationships:", self.rel or "none")

    def save(self, name):
        os.makedirs(self.save_dir, exist_ok=True)
        data = {"node": self.node, "items": sorted(self.items),
                "flags": sorted(self.flags), "rel": self.rel, "log": self.log}
        with open(os.path.join(self.save_dir, name + ".json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f)

    def load(self, name):
        with open(os.path.join(self.save_dir, name + ".json")) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        self.node = data["node"]
        self.items = set(data["items"])
        self.flags = set(data["flags"])
        self.rel = data["rel"]
        self.log = data["log"]

    def run(self):
        while True:
            node = self.story["nodes"][self.node]
            print("\n" + "=" * 60)
            print(node["text"].strip())
            if node.get("ending"):
                print("\n*** ENDING: " + node["ending"] + " ***")
                self.status()
                return
            opts = self.available(node)
            if not opts:
                print("\nThe way forward is barred. Your tale ends here.")
                return
            for i, c in enumerate(opts, 1):
                print("  %d. %s" % (i, c["text"]))
            cmd = input("\nChoose a number (or 'status', 'save NAME', "
                        "'load NAME', 'quit'): ").strip()
            if cmd == "status":
                self.status()
                continue
            if cmd.startswith("save "):
                self.save(cmd[5:].strip())
                print("Saved.")
                continue
            if cmd.startswith("load "):
                try:
                    self.load(cmd[5:].strip())
                    print("Loaded.")
                except Exception as e:
                    print("Load failed:", e)
                continue
            if cmd == "quit":
                return
            try:
                pick = opts[int(cmd) - 1]
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                print("Invalid choice.")
                continue
            self.log.append((self.node, pick["text"]))
            self.apply(pick.get("effects"))
            self.node = pick["next"]
